confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Colombo prices, not checked against live menus or booking pages. Restaurant meal anchors are the most reliable. Beer and cocktail prices are less certain because Sri Lankan alcohol taxes are high and change often. Hotel and hostel anchors are the least certain because rates vary widely by neighbourhood, season and booking channel.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Colombo as the commercial capital of Sri Lanka, with restaurant and bar prices above much of the rest of the island and hotel prices in line with other Sri Lankan tourist hubs. Alcohol is priced high relative to food because of excise and import duties.
